notes.title: Free shooter Straftat gets a 2v2 update and if my maths are correct this makes it twice as intense 1v1
notes.content:
You already knew hectic 1v1 bullet sprayer Straftat was going to add 2v2 matches and a four-player free-for-all mode. You knew because I told you months ago. Don't pretend you forgot. Please, it's insulting. Anyway, the update that adds these modes arrived yesterday and it also adds - surprise! - a ton of new maps. Which brings the game's total number of killing arenas to over 300. Straft THAT, other shooters.

Read more

notes.title: The best FPS of 2024 simply cannot stop adding new maps, introducing 37 new arenas, 4 new weapons, and a 'Horrible Smelly Head' in its latest update
notes.content: Rarely have I been so instantly enamoured with a game as Straftat, a gleefully chaotic micro-FPS created by two brothers who couldn't find a decent deathmatch shooter to play. Straftat pitches two players against each other in lightning-paced 1v1 duels. Less of a throwback and more of a distillation of the classic deathmatches of yore—particularly Half-Life with shades of Quake and Unreal in there too—it features dozens of weapons, 150 small yet wildly inventive maps, and a wonderful selection of hats, all for the low, low price of nothing... Read more.

notes.title: The best FPS of 2024 just got a surprise free update with 30 new maps, 9 new weapons, and just one cheeky cosmetic
notes.content: STRAFTAT, the winner of our Best FPS of 2024 award, has just come out with a beefy free update that consists of 30 new maps (plus three more for DLC-owning players), nine new weapons, new features and QoL tweaks, as well as a lone new suit for the arena shooter's delightfully ugly little potato men... Read more.

notes.title: JANUARY FREE UPDATE
notes.content:
This update adds a lot of new content, including new maps, new weapons and new features. Thank you for your patience as we continue to work on the game and improve it !

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]NEW MAPS[/h1]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h3]This update adds [b]30 free maps[/b] to the game as well as 3 DLC maps.[/h3]
Here is a list of the new maps included in the base game : 
[list]
[*] TheSamePlace (a total of 15 maps)
[*] Stroke (a total of 2 maps)
[*] StLucia (a total of 5 maps)
[*] ReeperBahn (a total of 2 maps)
[*] Patio_00
[*] HighWall_00
[*] LostCity_00
[*] Adread_00
[*] EndGame
[*] Canliferous_map
[/list]
The new DLC maps are : 
[list]
[*] Chateaux_13_Alt_Alt
[*] LostCity_00_Alt
[*] StLucia_00_Alt
[*] [i]More alt maps coming soon[/i]
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]NEW WEAPONS[/h1]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h3] 9 New Weapons added to the game, that can mostly be found in the new maps listed above. [/h3]
[b]Including : [/b]
[list]
[*] AP Mine
[*] Bukanee
[*] Hill H15
[*] FG42
[*] HK Caws
[*] HK G11
[*] QCW05
[*] Webley
[*] New Melee Weapon : [b]The Katana[/b]
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[list]
[*] Added an [b]active playlist[/b] system. The active playlist is always automatically loaded when you host a lobby, even after restarting the game. Your active playlist can be set in the maps menu.
[*] Added [b]rematch voting[/b] at the end of a game. Both players need to vote in order to rematch.
[*] Added a [b]tutorial map[/b] for beginners or newbies
[*] Added the ability to [b]rebind your Right Fire and Left Fire[/b] keys.
[*] New [b]Lobby Renaming[/b] feature
[*] Added one new DLC suit
[*] Added three new taunts (keys 4, 5 and 6)
[/list]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h1]FIXES[/h1]
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[list]
[*] Your first person arms now show the correct skin (instead of always the default one)
[*] Fixed reload rebinding
[*] Ladders can now be shot through
[*] Improved mouse sensitivity sliders (you can now lower your sensitivity down to 0.005)
[*] Nerfed phoenix
[*] You can't look around anymore when you are tased
[/list]
